alt: A blue paper cutout in the shape of a microphone icon placed in the center of concentric, wavy white paper rings on a light background.
caption: A blue paper cutout microphone sits at the center of concentric white, wavy rings.
description: A close-up macro shot of a layered paper craft design featuring a central blue circle with a white microphone icon. The background consists of multiple ring-shaped cutouts with irregular, wavy edges that radiate outward, creating a textured, topographical effect in white and light beige tones.
